facts.statement: The manually navigable fictional walkthrough now executes deterministic sample, measurement, exception and QA actions.
The fictional pH range is 6.8–7.2. Entering 6.4 and assessing it creates a below-range exception; root cause is not inferred.
Analyst, QA and Lab Manager are demo roles. The controller enforces Pack action permissions; these roles do not establish real user identity.
Synthetic approval requires completed tests, assessed results, resolved exceptions, a documented QA rationale, and an approved linked review.
Acme is fictional. This Pack provides no evidence of a real vendor capability, regulatory compliance or enterprise readiness.

approvedQA.question: What can I explore today?
approvedQA.answer: Explore four fictional paths and execute the deterministic sample-to-QA workflow. All actions affect synthetic session state only.

approvedQA.question: Why does this sample have an exception?
approvedQA.answer: An entered pH outside the fictional 6.8–7.2 range creates an exception when assessed. The demo does not infer a root cause.

approvedQA.question: Does this represent a real vendor or establish compliance?
approvedQA.answer: No. Acme is fictional, and this Pack makes no real vendor, compliance or enterprise-readiness claim.
